The transmission function changes the selected branch index’s name from the component name (such as `"Link"`) to `"name"`. Pandas selection can preserve that index name in `efficiency[idx]`, which affects how linopy aligns or broadcasts the efficiency coefficients against the operational variable’s `"name"` dimension. Thus, with multiple branches having different efficiencies, this can change the expression’s value even under legacy semantics without flat snapshots.
